entries.name: Cowfolk
entries.content:
Cowfolk, or Cow-people, are a race of demihumans with cow-like traits. They often feature short, muzzled faces with cow-like noses, large and pudgy builds, and a penchant for docile and peace-loving behavior. Cowfolk have human-level intelligence.
Female cowfolk lactate, even when not pregnant. They often have large breasts, and will need consistent milking at least three times a week.
Cowfolk are often housed on farms, to properly care for and tend to their needs. Whilst seen in many portions of the world as livestock, Cowfolk are treated well.
Cowfolk have different metabolisms and body compositions to normal humans. A BMI above 30.0 is typical for them, and their body systems are designed to function even with large amounts of fat through a series of esoteric body processes not fully understood by modern science. In layman's terms, they can get real fat, and never suffer many of the more dangerous consequences that a normal human would, such as diabetes or arterial clogging.
